message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "The zip entry name returned by ZipEntry.getName() is attacker-controlled and is used directly in `new File(dir, entry.getName())` without validating that the resulting path stays inside the temporary directory. That File is then passed to `new FileOutputStream(file)`, so entries containing `../`, absolute paths, or other path traversal sequences reach the FileOutputStream sink unguarded by any normalization or containment check."}]}
